views.label: Browsing the website
views.note: Most visits are served from cache. No application code runs for a cached page.

views.label: Photos and videos
views.note: Media loads straight from Cloudflare. Only cache misses reach R2 storage.

views.label: Consultation enquiry
views.note: The bot check is verified on the server before anything is sent to Zoho.

views.label: Treatment booking
views.note: SimplyBook takes and confirms bookings. The website stores none.

views.label: Optional database
views.note: Only added if TPS wants to keep its own copy of records.

components.label: Website visitors
components.explanation: Planning assumption of 10,000 to 50,000 monthly visitors. Each visitor's browser talks to three services directly: Vercel for pages and the form, Cloudflare for media, SimplyBook for bookings.

components.label: Vercel edge network
components.explanation: Vercel's CDN caches the prebuilt pages close to visitors and applies its web application firewall. A cache hit is answered here and does not execute any application function, so it adds no compute cost.

components.label: Website pages
components.explanation: Pages are generated at build time with Next.js and deployed to Vercel. Proposed region: London (illustrative). No separate NestJS or API server is needed for this scope.

components.label: Cloudflare CDN
components.explanation: Media files are referenced by direct URLs in the page, so browsers fetch them from Cloudflare, never through the TPS application. Cached copies are served from Cloudflare's edge.

components.label: Photo + video storage
components.explanation: Object storage holding videos (143.15 MB, 84.13%) and images (27 MB, 15.87%). Read only on a CDN cache miss. R2 has no charge for direct internet egress under the pricing used in planning.

components.label: Bot check
components.explanation: Runs in the consultation form and gives the browser a one-time token. It is a bot check, not a login, and not complete DDoS protection.

components.label: Form handler
components.explanation: A small server function on Vercel. It verifies the Turnstile token with Cloudflare, validates input, applies rate limits, and only then forwards the enquiry to Zoho. Proposed Standard size: 1 vCPU / 2 GB per instance. If Zoho's own hosted form is chosen instead, this handler is not needed.

components.label: Token verification
components.explanation: Server-to-server check using the secret key, which never leaves the server. An invalid token means the enquiry is rejected and nothing reaches Zoho.

components.label: Zoho
components.explanation: Destination for consultation enquiries. To confirm before build: whether TPS uses this handler or a Zoho hosted form/link, and the integration and authentication method.

components.label: SimplyBook
components.explanation: Visitors choose a treatment and book on SimplyBook, which handles confirmation. The website stores no bookings. To confirm: link out or embedded widget.

components.label: Database connector
components.explanation: Code library the form handler would use to save records, only if TPS needs local persistence.

components.label: Database
components.explanation: Optional. Not needed if Zoho and SimplyBook keep all records and the site has no logins. If needed, choose one host; Neon is recommended when only PostgreSQL is required.

boundaries.label: Optional: only if TPS keeps its own records
